packageRules.description: crank v2 lives in the github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 module, so the go run path in ci.mk only resolves v1 versions.
Antora image tags have four parts (3.1.14.1). The default semver-coerced versioning drops the fourth, so revision-only releases would never produce a PR.
Stay on Crossplane 1.x until the E2E setup moves to v2: v2 removed --enable-composition-revisions, and the provider never becomes Healthy on it.

customManagers.description: Track Make variables annotated with a renovate: comment on the line above, such as the kind node image and the Helm charts the E2E setup installs. No built-in manager reads Makefiles.
